title: Shared domain-neutral agent packet dogfood core contract v1 (#11024 family)
description: Domain-neutral core consumed by every agent packet dogfood row (distribution #11638, reload #11268, zed #11715, parser P05 #11024, analysis-train #11598, clippy packets #11654, authority-transfer #11704). Owns only: packet/tree/spec identity digests, agent/model/tool/permission subject metadata, bounded observable event/result records, the closed disposition vocabulary (started / completed / refused / transferred / not_proven), human-intervention ledger fields, mutated-packet negative-control checks, deterministic serialization of reports, and commit-hygiene guards (no chain-of-thought, no credentials, no machine-local paths, no unbounded logs). Domain manifests extend the core only through their own versioned schemas; widening this core requires an $id and schema_version bump. This contract generates no packets, executes no agents, performs no network access, and gates no merge on model behavior.

run_id.description: Stable caller-assigned identity of one synthetic or live dogfood run.

events.description: Bounded, strictly ascending, contiguously sequenced observable records. Order is semantic state of the document, never filesystem enumeration order.

results.description: Bounded terminal records of one run; own contiguous sequence space starting at 0.

human_intervention.description: Human-intervention ledger. Every entry names the event boundary it applies at and the operator role; a packet that hides intervention is invalid.

metadata.description: Non-semantic caller metadata. Excluded from the canonical identity and every projection; may never carry assignment, lease, liveness, or frontier state.

sha256_hex.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest recomputed by the validator from canonical bytes; self-reported values are never trusted.

packet_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical integrity envelope of this run; the validator recomputes it and rejects any drift (mid-run tamper negative control).

tree_sha.description: Exact source tree the run was executed against.

spec_ref.description: Durable governing spec anchor (issue, ADR, or schema $id).

spec_digest.description: SHA-256 binding the packet to the governing spec revision.

subject.description: Subject metadata identifying who ran. Required and complete: a run without model, tool, agent, or permission-scope-ceiling identity fails closed instead of being accepted as anonymous.

ceiling.description: Closed upper bound of permission scopes the subject held during the run; dropping the ceiling is a fail-closed violation.

disposition.description: Closed outcome vocabulary of the shared core: started / completed / refused / transferred / not_proven.

at_ms.description: Optional monotonic offset timestamp in milliseconds; included in the record digest when present.

payload.description: Bounded retained evidence. Subject to retention caps and hygiene scanning: no chain-of-thought keys, no credentials, no machine-local paths, no unbounded logs.

digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical form of {seq, kind, at_ms?, payload}; the validator recomputes it instead of trusting it.

before_seq.description: Event sequence boundary the intervention applied before; must exist in events.
